notes: The input is the arguments of one append. args.last_seq is the sequence of the last line of the journal before the append. args.moment is the time of the line, in the ISO 8601 form of Python.
The entry point takes each body. It does not check a body against its kind. The body of each vector has a form that attendance.service writes, or a form that the contract leaves free.

The body of a pi_event has free form, and so has the body of a note that the service does not write. Every object of free form inside args has its keys in sorted order. A vector file sorts keys, and the Python code keeps the order that it is given.
output is the exact line that the Python code writes, with its LF.

body.prompt: Which sensor dropped out last night?
